rationale: The task is explicitly limited to a read-only readiness inspection and introduces no product semantics, repository mutation, formal artefact, approval, or delivery action. Canonical routing therefore permits ungated diagnostic execution under Quick Task Mode. The missing UR approval and Brownfield decision do not block this non-authorizing inspection, but they would block any later gated change or implementation. Compact Delivery is unavailable because its required approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, and stored quick_task context are absent.
decision_grounds: Task scope is a read-only OpenCode provider and agent readiness precheck.
The router excludes questions, explanations, local inspections, and explicitly scoped reviews from the default gate-cer:
No approval or Brownfield decision is present, so no gated implementation or formal delivery stage is permissible.
Quick Task Mode covers small reviews and local inspections without new product semantics.
The task has no proposed diff, so the Non-Normative Trivial Change Boundary for qualifying diffs is not the applicable/b
